title: Digital Marketing VA
description:
About Us

TD
dia 
 is a specialist PPC agency focused on e-commerce clients. We manage paid search and shopping campaigns across Google and Microsoft Ads, working with a small portfolio of clients where performance really matters. We’re a small, close-knit team and we’re at a point where we need support to keep everything moving so our senior team can stay focused on strategy and client results.



The Role

We’re looking for a digitally-savvy VA to support us across four key areas: client reporting, new business admin, product feed work, and internal project management. You don’t need to be a PPC specialist - but you do need to be comfortable working inside digital marketing tools, following detailed processes precisely, and communicating clearly in writing.

This is a role for someone who is proactive, takes ownership of recurring tasks without being chased, and genuinely cares about the quality of their output. Over time, there is real scope to grow with us.



What You’ll Be Doing



Reporting & Data Compilation



We produce weekly and monthly performance reports for every client. The data-pulling and formatting is systematic and takes time we’d rather spend on analysis and strategy.

• Pull weekly and monthly performance figures from Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Data Studio, Shopify using templates and processes we provide

• Format reports accurately and consistently before they go to clients

• Maintain and update our Looker Studio reporting dashboards - fixing broken connections, updating date ranges, making layout tweaks (training provided)

• Help build and maintain an internal overview report tracking performance across all clients

• Flag anything that looks unusual in the data before reports go out



New Business Admin



We do outbound prospecting but it consistently gets deprioritised when client work is busy. We need someone to keep this pipeline moving.



• Manage outbound
 sequences in Instantly - loading contact lists, scheduling sends, monitoring reply rates, and flagging responses that need a founder to reply

• Research and qualify prospective clients against criteria we provide (industry, platform, revenue signals, etc.)

• Format, update, and maintain pitch decks and proposal documents in Google Slides

• Follow up with existing clients for testimonials and case study content

• Keep our prospect tracker up to date and organised



Product Feed & Data Entry



Feed quality is a significant lever for our clients’ Google Shopping performance. A lot of the optimisation work is systematic rather than strategic - it’s time-consuming and well-suited to a detail-oriented VA working from clear guidelines.



• Update and optimise product feed data including titles, descriptions, product types, and Google Product Categories (GPCs) based on guidelines we provide

• Audit feeds for missing or incomplete attributes and flag or fix them

• Assist with feed uploads and quality checks in Google Merchant Center

• Help maintain a consistent approach to product categorisation across client accounts



Project Admin & Asana Management



We manage all client and internal work in Asana. Keeping it clean, current, and useful is a small but constant task that often falls by the wayside.



• Keep Asana organised across client and internal projects - tasks assigned, due dates set, completed work marked off

• Chase outstanding tasks and flag anything that’s overdue or blocked to the relevant tea
mber

• Assist with meeting prep - pulling together notes, task summaries, and status updates ahead of client or internal calls

• Help maintain our internal SOPs and process documentation as we build them out

• General day-to-day admin to keep the team running smoothly



What We’re Looking For



Essential

• Excellent written English - you may be communicating with clients and partners on our behalf

• High attention to detail and a track record of accurate, consistent work

• Comfortable working inside Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive)

• Experience with a project management tool such as Asana, Trello, or Monday

• Some exposure to digital marketing or an agency environment - you don’t need to be a specialist, but you need to be comfortable in that world

• Reliable, proactive, and clear in your communication - if something is unclear, you ask before it becomes a problem

• Able to follow detailed written processes accurately and flag when something doesn’t look right



Desirable

• Hands-on experience with Google Ads or Google Merchant Center (read-only access, reporting, or feed management)

• Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 or Looker Studio

• Experience working with Shopify - even at a basic admin level

• Prior experience managing product feed data or e-commerce data entry

• Experience with cold
 platforms such as Instantly



What We Offer

• Fully remote with flexible working hours

• Clear onboarding with documented processes - we set you up to succeed

• A small team where your work has a direct and visible impact

• Consistent, long-term engagement - this is not a one-off project

• Real scope to grow the role as trust develops

We need a freelancer to audit and fix conversion tracking for one client account.



The setup recorded conversions consistently through April. A GTM change made on May 8-9 combined multiple GA4 form submission events into one, and conversions dropped to near zero from May 10 onward. The GTM container has had changes made by multiple people, so the specialist may inherit a setup that is not fully documented.



A separate concern is that GA4 conversion tracking is also not recording correctly, which means we cannot separate paid from organic leads or establish a reliable baseline for Google Ads performance.



What you will do



Fix GA4 event tracking first so form submissions are attributed by channel, then fix the Google Ads conversion action so paid form submissions record correctly.



Specifically:



- review GTM version history for May 8-9 and determine whether the event consolidation caused the drop, or whether another change contributed

- Determine whether the WordPress form submissions are firing the correct GTM trigger, and fix the connection if not.

- Fix the GA4 form submission event so leads are attributed by channel

- Fix the Google Ads conversion action for form submissions

- Verify that consent mode is correctly implemented so Google can model conversions for users who decline cookies on the Cookiebot popup, rather than simply blocking tags on rejection

- Configure the enhanced conversions if necessary

- Document what you changed and why



Tools and platforms involved



- Google Tag Manager

- Google Analytics 4

- Google Ads conversion tracking

- Cookiebot by Usercentrics 

- WordPress



Required skills



- Hands-on experience diagnosing and fixing conversion tracking in GTM, including inherited containers with undocumented changes

- Experience configuring consent mode with a CMP such as Cookiebot

- Ability to trace how WordPress forms push events and how GTM triggers listen for them, and make corrections without breaking existing functionality

- Hands-on experience configuring Google Ads conversion actions



Scope



This is a one-time project with the option to continue on a retainer basis. This role covers tracking implementation and debugging only, not campaign management, bidding, or audience strategy.



How to apply



Send a short message describing a conversion tracking issue you diagnosed and fixed before. Include the tools you used and what the root cause turned out to be.



Looking forward to connect with you!



Best,

Nick

title: VSL AI Editor
description:
End-to-End AI Video Producer & VSL Expert – E-Commerce Store

About the Role



We are looking for a highly skilled, AI-native VSL (Video Sales Letter) Specialist for our online store.



You will not just be editing videos; you will be orchestrating the entire AI generation and production pipeline to produce high-converting VSLs ranging from 1 to 10 minutes in length.



How We Work



We provide the video scripts and our product images. Your job is to handle the entire process from scratch:



Starting Frames – Creating hyper-realistic starting images using models like Nano Banana 2 or GPT Image 2.



Video Generation – Animating these frames into high-quality B-roll and product-in-use scenes using advanced video models like Seedance 2.0 via API platforms like Kie.ai. You must know how to use multimodal reference images to keep our product visually consistent across scenes.



Voiceover & Audio – Generating natural, high-converting voiceovers using tools like ElevenLabs or MiniMax, perfectly synced to the video.



Assembly & Editing – Stitching everything together, matching the pacing scene-by-scene, adjusting speed, and adding captions in CapCut Pro, Premiere, or After Effects.



Workflow Automation – Utilizing Claude Code to orchestrate, analyze scripts, and streamline your prompt engineering tasks.



Requirements



Expert-level knowledge of the latest AI video and image models, including Seedance 2.0, Sora 2, Veo 3, GPT Image 2 / Nano Banana Pro.



API Experience – Deep understanding of how to generate content through API aggregators like Kie.ai or Fal.ai to manage generation costs and access raw models.



Agentic Workflows – Experience using Claude Code or similar agentic coding systems to manage your creative workflows and prompts.



Product Consistency – Proven ability to use reference inputs to make an AI character hold or use a specific product naturally without AI artifacts or distortion.



Editing Mastery – Strong skills in pacing, transitions, and visual storytelling for direct-response e-commerce video ads.



Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to deliver consistent quality.



The Paid Test



We only hire highly skilled experts. Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid test where you will create a 2-minute video ad based on our script.



You will use our product image to independently generate AI scenes of our product in use, add the AI voiceover, and provide the final edited video.



Current Workload & Pay



Approximately 4 hours per day, Monday to Friday, with plans to scale up to full-time as we grow.



Pay: $5–$15/hour depending on your exact skill level, speed, and portfolio quality.



In addition to the hourly pay, we pay a performance bonus of $50 to $150 for every video that becomes a winning video.



Our video editors usually earn between $1,000 and $3,000 per month, depending on workload, speed, quality, and the number of winning videos they produce.

title: Lead Video Editor & QA Supervisor (Real Estate)
description:
COMPENSATION STRUCTURE (Hybrid Base + Per Video):

This is a hybrid role designed to give you guaranteed management income PLUS high-earning potential for premium edits.



The Base: You will be paid a guaranteed $17/hr for all management, QA, team coaching, and template creation (hours will be capped weekly to ensure a healthy balance).



The Upside: You will also be our exclusive editor for our VIP clients & high-value signature videos. These are paid on a flat per-video rate that is higher than our standard editing rate. The faster and better you edit, the more you make.



IMPORTANT SEASONALITY NOTE: Real estate is highly seasonal. Please be aware that our volume typically drops to near zero during December and January. During these two months, there may be weeks with no videos to edit and no QA hours required. This role is best suited for someone who is comfortable capitalizing on the high volume during the spring, summer, and fall, and budgeting for the winter slowdown.



The Role:

We are a high-volume Canadian Real Estate Media Agency looking for a Lead Video Editor & QA Supervisor. We already have a capable team of young, talented editors, but we need a true LEADER to run the floor.



This is a "Player-Coach" role. You will spend part of your time supervising the team and enforcing our systems, and the rest of your time serving as our elite editor for high-value luxury properties and VIP clients.



If you just want to put your headphones on and edit all day without talking to anyone, do not apply. If you are an agency veteran who knows how to hold a team accountable, enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs), and edit at a world-class level, this role is for you.



What You Will Do (The Supervisor - QA & Management):



Enforce & Expand the Asset Library: We have a foundational library of graphics, templates, and fonts, but we want you to make it better. You must ensure 100% team compliance with the shared library, while actively contributing your own assets (LUTs, SFX, custom presets) to help "level up" our entire agency's product.



Daily QA: Review horizontal real estate walkthroughs and vertical Reels (Hormozi-style/retention editing) submitted by the team. Check for North American pacing, comedic timing, and spelling errors in captions.



Direct Feedback: Provide clear, private, and direct feedback to editors to fix their mistakes before our strict 24-hour client deadlines.



What You Will Do (The Player - VIP Edits):



Act as the lead editor for our luxury Canadian listings ($3M+ properties).



Edit dynamic, trendy, 60-second Reels for our top-tier real estate agents, utilizing AI captioning tools to maximize efficiency.



Create and update Final Cut Pro titles, generators, and effects for the rest of the team to use to keep our workflow homogenized.



Requirements:



Leadership: You MUST be comfortable giving direct feedback and rejecting poor work. You cannot be afraid to tell an editor to redo a project.



Experience: 4+ years of high-level video editing (Final Cut Pro / Apple Motion) specifically for real estate, and 1+ years in a QA, Team Lead, or Post-Production Supervisor role.



Trend Awareness: Deep understanding of current North American social media trends, pacing, and retention-style captioning.



Tech-Savvy: Experience working with shared cloud environments and standardizing folder structures.



Our Standard:

To get an idea of our current baseline and what we expect you to maintain and elevate, check out our work here: 



CRITICAL RULE: Do not DM us on social media or attempt to contact us outside of OnlineJobs.ph. All applications must go through this platform. Contacting our agency directly will result in immediate disqualification.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY):

To prove you have the management skills we need and that you pay attention to detail, please include the word "MAPLE" in the subject line of your application.



In your proposal, you must include:

Your Portfolio: A link to your previous work showcasing REAL ESTATE video edits only. We need to see examples of both horizontal property walkthroughs and trendy, vertical Reels. (Please do not send wedding, gaming, or generic showreels).



The Scenario Question: Answer this exact scenario: One of our fastest editors submits a great real estate video, but they completely ignored our standard asset library and used their own fonts and transitions. The client deadline is in 3 hours. How do you handle the editor, and how do you handle the video?

title: Transaction Coordinator | Full-Time | Onsite (Metro Manila) | US Business Hours | Night Shift
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We are a US-based real estate operations company looking to hire 3 full-time Transaction Coordinators to work from our coworking office in Metro Manila / Quezon. This is an onsite position — not work from home. You will manage real estate transactions from contract to close for US brokerages and real estate teams across multiple states. We use AI-powered tools and proven systems so you can focus on what matters: accuracy, communication, and getting files closed on time.



We are growing fast and hiring urgently. Top performers will have a clear path to Team Lead and management roles as the team scales from 5 to 15+ people.



JOB DETAILS

 

Position: Transaction Coordinator

Number of Openings: 3



Location: Onsite — Coworking Space in Metro Manila / Quezon



Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM (US Client Timezone)



Shift Type: Night Shift / Graveyard (Manila time)



Employment Type: Full-Time, Long-Term

US States Covered: California, Colorado, Texas, Florida — expanding to additional states



Accuracy Standard: 97% minimum required



Growth Opportunity: Team Lead and Management track available for top performers



TIMEZONE COVERAGE

Your shift will be based on the US client’s local timezone. Below are the current states we serve and what the hours look like in Manila time:

 

US State Client Timezone



Florida

Eastern Time

8:00 PM – 6:00 AM

Urgent Hire



Texas

Central Time

9:00 PM – 7:00 AM

Urgent Hire



Colorado

Mountain Time

10:00 PM – 8:00 AM

Urgent Hire



California

Pacific Time

11:00 PM – 9:00 AM

Urgent Hires



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage US real estate transactions from executed contract through closing, including buyer-side, seller-side, and listing files.

• Set up and maintain transaction files in our AI-powered TC platform. Ensure all documents, deadlines, and milestones are accurately entered and tracked.

• Send all transaction-related
s to agents, title companies, lenders, and vendors on behalf of the brokerage.

• Monitor compliance deadlines: inspections, appraisals, earnest money deposits, escrow, financing contingencies, and closing dates.

• Submit compliance files and documentation to the brokerage’s compliance platform. Ensure all paperwork meets state-specific requirements.

• Chase missing documents. Follow up persistently on outstanding items. Escalate when needed through the proper chain.

• Manage your task board,
 inbox, and reminder systems daily. Nothing falls through the cracks.

• Process rental compliance files and documentation review as assigned.

• Maintain 97?curacy across all file processing, document handling, and compliance submissions. This is non-negotiable.



TOOLS YOU WILL USE

Training will be provided on all tools. Prior experience is a plus but not required.

• AI-powered transaction coordination platform (primary tool for file management, tasks, and communications)

• Compliance and file submission platform

• Shared inbox / team
 management tool

• CRM for contact management

• Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Meet, Chat)

• DocuSign, SkySlope, Dotloop, ZipForms for electronic document signing



HOW WE MEASURE PERFORMANCE

We use a scorecard system. Every TC is measured on five dimensions:

 

Production Volume - 30%

Handle your assigned file load consistently



Timeliness - 25%

Meet SLA deadlines — 85%+ compliance required



Accuracy - 25% accuracy, less than 5% error rate, zero major errors



Communication - 10%

Responsive, professional, proactive with agents and team



Process Adherence - 10%

Follow SOPs, checklists, and escalation protocols

 

Bonus pay is available for TCs who exceed their baseline file count and maintain high scorecard scores. We reward accuracy and volume.



WORK ENVIRONMENT

• You will work onsite at our coworking office in Metro Manila. Cameras on during business hours. This is how we build a real team — not a group of strangers working alone at home.

• Daily standups with your manager and teammates.

• Clear SOPs, compliance checklists, and escalation chains for every state you support. You will never be guessing what to do next.

• We invest heavily in AI and technology to remove the repetitive work. You focus on the judgment calls, follow-ups, and client communication that actually matter.

• Professional, structured environment. We expect accountability, reliability, and attention to detail every single day.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

We are not hiring for 5 people and stopping. We are building a full operations team in Manila and scaling quickly. Here is what your career path looks like:

 

Level 1

Transaction Coordinator

You start here. Learn multi-state workflows, hit 97% accuracy, prove you are reliable.



Level 2

Senior TC / State Specialist

Own a state cluster. Train new hires. Handle complex files and escalations.



Level 3

Team Lead

Manage a pod of 3–5 TCs. Run QC audits, monitor SLAs, lead daily standups for your group.



Level 4

Operations Manager

Run the full Manila office. Client relationships. New state launches. Report directly to the CEO.

 

We promote from within. The Team Leads and Managers of this company will come from the people we hire today.



HIRING PROCESS

We have a structured hiring process. Here is exactly what to expect:

 

1. Application — Submit your resume/CV, a 60–90 second personal intro video (Loom or Google Drive), DISC profile, typing speed test result, internet speed screenshot, and computer specs screenshot.

2. Skills Assessment — 3 written scenario questions testing how you prioritize, solve problems, and handle ambiguity. No trick questions — we want to see how you think.

3. Interview — 30-minute video call with the CEO and TC Manager.

4. Two-Week Paid Trial — You will work real files with daily milestones and performance tracking. Six-day work weeks during trial period.

5. Offer Decision — Based on your trial performance. If you pass, you receive a formal offer letter.

 

HOW TO APPLY

Click Apply and submit the following:

? Updated resume/CV

? Personal intro video (60–90 seconds, Loom or Google Drive link)

? DISC assessment result

? Typing speed test screenshot (
 or similar)

? Internet speed test screenshot (speedtest.net)

? Computer specs screenshot (System Information)



• We do not micromanage, but we do measure everything. If you thrive in a structured, performance-driven environment, this is for you.

 

If you cannot follow the application instructions above, that tells us everything we need to know. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

 

We are looking for people who want to grow with a company that is scaling fast, investing in its team, and building something real. If that’s you — apply now.



Mention the word “GROWTH” in your application. Apply here: 



• No experience need but bonus if you have experience with business working environment or real estate transaction coordination or as a VA supporting US-based real estate agents/teams.

• Solid understanding of the US real estate transaction lifecycle: contract execution, inspection period, appraisal, financing contingency, clear to close, and closing or willingness to learn quickly. 

• Excellent written English. You will be
ing agents, title companies, lenders, and brokers daily. Grammar and professionalism matter.

• Able and willing to work US hours (night/graveyard shift in Manila), Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM in the assigned US timezone.

• Willing to work onsite at our coworking office in Metro Manila / Quezon. This is NOT a work-from-home position.

• Own laptop or desktop: minimum 8GB RAM, SSD required.

• Can maintain 97% accuracy across all tasks. We measure this.



Nice to Have:

• Experience with SkySlope, Follow Up Boss, Missive, DocuSign, Dotloop, ZipForms or Google Workspace.

• Familiarity with state-specific compliance requirements in FL, TX, CO, or CA.

• Bonus if experience managing 20+ active transaction files at the same time.

• Typing speed of 50+ WPM.

• DISC profile completed (or willingness to complete one).

• Bonus if experience with MLS systems or transaction management platforms.

• Long-term commitment preferred. We are building a team, not filling seats.

title: Account & Driver Partnership Specialist
description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!



Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). 

Visit our website: 



Position: Account & Driver Partnership Specialist

Work Schedule: US Hours (EST)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)  

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long Term

Salary Range: USD 1,200 - 1,800 / Month

Benefit: PTO and HMO after the 120-day probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide

Performance Bonus: Starts at approximately USD 300–700 per month on average, with potential for higher earnings based on performance. 



About the role:



As an Account & Driver Partnerships Specialist, you will own the operational health of a specific US market. You'll start by learning that market inside and out, its clients, its drivers, its trip patterns, and from there, you'll wear two hats every day. Both are essential to how Wingz works.



On the client side, you'll act as the dedicated account manager for our partnered NEMT brokers, the organizations that send trip requests for their members. You'll handle daily B2B communication, trip coordination, escalation management, and performance reporting. Your job is to build a strong partnership with each broker and earn their trust until Wingz is their most reliable carrier in the market. That trust matters — it's what causes brokers to route more trips to us. And once they do, you'll own the commitment to make sure every assigned trip gets completed safely and on time.



On the driver side, you'll own the full driver lifecycle in your market, recruitment, onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention. That means walking new drivers through every requirement, procedure, and process so they can confidently join the NEMT industry with Wingz. It means proactively reaching out to inactive drivers and reactivating them. It means being the human point of contact that keeps drivers engaged, earning, and partnered with us long-term — because retention isn't built on incentives, it's built on relationships.



This is a foundational individual-contributor role, by design. You'll start at the rank-and-file level because the path forward at Wingz is clear: Specialist ? Senior Specialist ? Market Lead. We're not hiring for a job; we're hiring for a career, and the people who learn the Wingz foundation now are the leaders we promote into the next phase of growth.



Key Responsibilities:



• Learn your market first. Get to know the clients, the drivers, the trip patterns, and the relationships that make your assigned market work; your fluency here is the foundation for everything else.

• Build strong partnerships with our NEMT broker clients. Show up consistently, communicate clearly, and follow through every time. Your goal is to make Wingz the trusted, reliable carrier in your market, so brokers route more trips to us.

• Commit to trip completion. Once a trip is assigned to Wingz, you own it. Coordinate with drivers, monitor trips in progress, and resolve issues quickly so every member gets to their appointment safely and on time.

• Onboard new drivers into the Wingz partnership. Walk them through every requirement, procedure, and process, documentation, background checks, vehicle readiness, so they can confidently join the NEMT industry as a Wingz partner driver.

• Activate inactive drivers. Make the calls, understand what's holding them back, and get them back on the road.

• Drive partner-driver success. Be the human point of contact our drivers can count on. Build loyalty, prevent churn, and grow retention in your market, because every retained driver is one we don't have to replace.

• Help drivers grow their daily earnings. Where needed, coordinate trip assignments and dispatch so your drivers see consistent, meaningful daily income. Strong earnings are what keep drivers partnered with Wingz long-term.

• Step into adjacent responsibilities as the team scales, operations support, dispatch backup, training new hires, and wherever the business needs you most.

• Bring market-level insights back to the wider Wingz team to inform how we improve.



Qualifications:



• Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience. Client relations, account management, partner success, leadership or supervisory roles, or experience handling drivers and partners at a US-based, or international transportation, rideshare, logistics, or gig-economy company (Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Instacart, Rappi, DiDi, Cabify, 99, iFood, PedidosYa, inDrive, Loggi, Bolt, Wolt, or similar). What matters is the underlying skill set, not the exact job title.

• Experience working directly with US-based clients or a US-based company. You're already comfortable with US business culture, US English, and the pace of a US-facing role.

• Strong written and verbal English communication. Clear, professional, and warm, you'll be working with US-based clients and drivers every day.

• Tech-savvy with strong initiative to learn. Quick to pick up new platforms (CRM, dispatch software, reporting tools, AI tools), and ready to step into adjacent tasks so your market never loses 
ntum.

• Available to work US Eastern Standard Time (EST). Shift schedules are set based on market and business needs; flexibility is part of the role.

• Proven remote work experience. You've worked from home effectively before, with minimal supervision, the discipline to manage your own day, and a track record of delivering outcomes without someone over your shoulder.

• Your own reliable computer, stable home internet, and a professional remote workspace. All work-from-home equipment is self-provided.

title: Podcast Manager/Editor/Virtual Assistant
description:
I'm looking for someone to take ownership of my podcast and help turn it into a consistent content and growth engine for my business.



The Master Your Mix Podcast is a weekly show focused on helping rock musicians, producers, and audio engineers create professional-quality recordings from their home studios. The podcast breaks down real-world recording, mixing, and production techniques in a practical way, with a strong focus on workflow, decision-making, and getting consistent results.



Episodes feature conversations with top-level engineers and producers, designed to help listeners improve their mixes and recordings. Past guests include engineers and producers such as Andrew Scheps, Sylvia Massy, David Bendeth, and Barrett Jones (bonus points if you include his episode number in your application).

, social, and video platforms.

 

Who We Are:

MasterYourMix is a music education business built around helping home studio musicians and producers get professional results from their recordings and mixes. The core belief is that great results don't require an expensive studio — they require the right process.



The business includes educational courses, a coaching program (Amplitude), and a line of audio plugins under the Carve Audio brand. The podcast is the primary content channel that drives awareness, builds trust with the audience, and feeds into the broader product ecosystem.



The host, Mike Indovina, is a mixing and mastering engineer with major label credits (Sony, Universal, Roadrunner, Republic, and others), a two-time #1 bestselling Amazon author, and a drummer. The show has featured some of the most respected engineers and producers in the industry.



This role exists to keep that content engine running and growing.

 

Compensation & Hours:

This is a part-time role averaging approximately 10 hours per week. That said, someone who builds smart systems and uses AI tools effectively may find the workload becomes lighter over time — that efficiency is encouraged, not penalized.

Guest Pipeline & Outreach

• Identify and research potential guests in music production, mixing, and audio engineering

The goal is to always have a steady flow of strong, relevant guests lined up.

The goal is to make each episode focused, engaging, and useful for listeners.

• Export final episodes



Publishing & Distribution

• Upload and schedule episodes in Captivate

• Preparing/publishing social media posts

nts from each episode

Each episode should generate multiple content assets, not just a single upload.



 Marketing

s promoting each episode that address common issues home studio musicians experience and how the episode will help listeners solve them

• Schedule
s inside Drip

Analytics & Optimization

• Track performance of episodes,
s, and content

• Strong content instincts: You can identify what makes a great clip, hook, or angle. You think about content from the audience's perspective, not just the logistics of publishing.

s, captions, and show notes should feel human and direct — not corporate or generic.

I'm not going to check in on you daily — you'll be expected to manage your own schedule, stay ahead of the pipeline, and flag issues before they become problems.

 marketing platforms like Drip

s are sent consistently and drive engagement

title: Operations Administrator
description:
About Us

We are a leading health and safety training centre based in Northern Ireland. We are committed to delivering high-quality training and compliance solutions. To support our growing operations, we are seeking a dedicated and versatile Opera-tions Administrator to join our team remotely.



The Role

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive, and honest individual to oversee the day-to-day operations of our training centre. This is a multifaceted role requir-ing a unique blend of administrative rigour, creative design capability, financial accuracy, and process improvement skills. The successful candidate must be computer proficient and capable of working independently in a home-based en-vironment, with no other outside employment.



Key Responsibilities

Operations & Administration

• Oversee the day-to-day operational workflow of the training centre, ensur-ing all administrative processes run smoothly and efficiently.

• Manage course scheduling, delegate bookings, and trainer coordination.

• Act as the first point of contact for client enquiries, providing excellent cus-tomer service via phone,
, and digital platforms.

• Prepare and issue course certificates, delegate materials, and pre-course documentation.

Graphics & Design

• Assist with credit control, following up on outstanding payments in a pro-fessional and timely manner.

• Prepare financial summaries and reports for management as required.



Process Improvement & Automation

• Analyse existing administrative and operational processes to identify inef-ficiencies.

• Build, document, and implement new workflows and automated systems to streamline repetitive tasks.

• Leverage technology to reduce manual data entry, improve accuracy, and enhance overall productivity.



General & Ad-Hoc Duties

• Provide general clerical support, including data entry, report generation, and minute-taking for meetings.

• Adapt to additional tasks as required, supporting the wider team to meet business objectives.

• Proactively identify and resolve operational issues before they escalate.



Person Specification

Essential Criteria

• Computer Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace. Ability to quickly learn and master new software and CRMs.

• Graphic Design: Proven experience with design tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop/InDesign), or similar to produce profes-sional marketing and internal materials.

• Bookkeeping: Experience with basic bookkeeping principles and famili-arity with accounting software such as QuickBooks, or Sage).

• Process Improvement: Demonstrable experience in building workflows and automating processes 

• Organisational Skills: Exceptional ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environ-ment.

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and courteous manner.

• Integrity: Must be honest, diligent, and trustworthy, with the ability to handle sensitive financial and client data responsibly.

• Home Working Capability: A quiet, dedicated home workspace with reliable high-speed internet access.



Desirable Criteria

• Previous experience working in a health and safety training environment or similar professional services sector.

• Qualification in bookkeeping or business administration.

• Knowledge of various softwares and tools 



Terms of Employment

• Working Arrangements: This is a fully remote, work-from-home posi-tion.

• Exclusivity: This is a full-time role. Due to the nature and demands of the position, no other concurrent employment or freelance work is permitted. Full commitment and focus on operations are required.

• Hours: Standard office hours, Monday to Friday. Flexibility may be required occasionally to meet business needs.

• Equipment: The successful candidate must have their own computer and reliable high-speed internet connection. Specific software licenses may be provided by the company.



How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your experience in operations, design, bookkeeping, and process workflows. Include examples of design work (portfolio or links) if available.

title: Excel Operations Specialist
description:
Job Title: Excel Operations Specialist

Department: Operations



About Self Bill Pro:

Self Bill Pro is a rapidly growing startup dedicated to solving one of the most persistent challenges in the employee benefits ecosystem: the complexity of monthly benefits billing. We provide a tech-enabled service where our dedicated team leverages proprietary software to eliminate the administrative burdens of manual invoice audits and costly billing errors. Our mission is to streamline this critical operation, freeing up employers, brokers, and carriers to focus on their strategic priorities.



About the Role:

The Excel Operations Analyst supports core billing workflows within Self Bill Pro’s Manual Data Operations (MDO) team, working primarily in Excel to manage, clean, and structure complex data.

This role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring you to work through high-volume, often imperfect datasets to ensure accurate invoicing and reconciliation. You’ll transform raw inputs, identify inconsistencies, and produce reliable outputs that power our billing processes.

While there are established workflows, success in this role requires independent problem-solving and sound judgment when working through unclear or incomplete data.

This is not a traditional business analyst role. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, strong in Excel, and comfortable balancing structured processes with practical, day-to-day data problem solving in a fast-paced environment.

Requirements



Key Responsibilities:

Work directly in Excel to manage, clean, and transform data used in billing workflows

Execute data preparation for invoicing and reconciliation across multiple clients

Identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies, inconsistencies, and missing information

Perform detailed data validation and quality checks prior to output delivery

Support plan setup and billing preparation activities for new and existing clients

Work through incomplete or unclear datasets, applying judgment to move work forward accurately

Maintain and update Excel files, templates, and structured datasets

Partner with internal teams to ensure accurate and timely data delivery

Identify recurring data issues and contribute to process improvements



Qualifications:

Advanced Excel proficiency, including complex formulas, lookups, data manipulation, and efficient handling of large datasets

Experience working with large, complex, or high-volume datasets

Proven ability to clean, validate, and transform data from multiple sources

High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and auditability

Ability to identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies and inconsistencies

Comfortable working with incomplete or unclear data, applying judgment to move work forward

Ability to follow structured processes while also adapting when needed

Strong organizational and time management skills in a fast-paced environment

Clear written and verbal communication skills

Required shift of US ET business hours (8pm–5am PHT), with potential transition to a second shift (3pm–12am PHT) following onboarding



Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working in employee benefits, insurance, or HR-related operations  

Familiarity with billing, invoicing, or reconciliation workflows  

Experience working with structured data formats (e.g., CSV, XML, LDE/LDEX)  

Exposure to process improvement or workflow optimization in a data-heavy environment  

Advanced Excel capabilities (e.g., Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/scripting)  



Why Join Self Bill Pro:

At Self Bill Pro, you’ll join a collaborative and ambitious team dedicated to transforming outdated processes through smart, scalable technology. If you are a highly motivated individual with a passion for technology and a desire to make a difference in the employee benefits landscape, we encourage you to apply!



Work Model:

Remote



Employment Type:

Full-Time, Permanent



Category:

Information Technology

Bachelor’s Degree



Required Experience:

Experienced



**Compensation is structured as monthly base pay inclusive of night differential, reflecting the scheduled working hours for this role. Scheduled hours are intended to align with U.S. Eastern Time. The 13th month pay is provided in addition to the stated base compensation in accordance with local requirements.**

title: Content Strategist
description:
About SuperWellness



SuperWellness is a UK-based consultancy working with senior leaders and organisations to embed wellbeing as a genuine driver of business success. We train wellbeing leads through our accredited Level 5 Diploma, advise boards on strategy, and in 2026 and 2027 we are launching two significant new initiatives — a research white paper and a national accreditation — that will substantially raise our profile.



We are a small team with a strong reputation, a growing body of original research, and a clear direction. We work with a distributed team including colleagues in the Philippines, and we take the working relationship seriously on both sides.



The Role



Content planning, creation, and coordination across four priorities.

Reporting directly into our CEO, this is not a pure execution role. We need someone who thinks clearly about audience and message, makes considered plans, and delivers on them. You will work closely with our CEO and Head of Wellbeing Strategy on content, and with our operations team on campaigns and distribution. You must be commercially-minded and driven to convert content into results.



Priority 01: Research Launch & Senior Leader Audience

In November 2026 we publish a major paper drawing on senior leaders' perspectives on wellbeing. You will lead the content campaign: teasers, pre-registration, launch-day push, and post-event nurture — and write our CEO's LinkedIn to build a credible voice with that audience.



Priority 02: Accreditation Launch & Marketing

A new national workplace wellbeing accreditation launches publicly in January 2027. You will write the narrative, the web copy, and the prospect content journey from free diagnostic to enquiry — and develop case studies as the first organisations are accredited.



Priority 03: Website Copy & Search Visibility

Write and maintain website copy across training, accreditation, and services — structured and optimised for both traditional SEO and AI-powered search. Identify and pursue guest post opportunities on relevant external platforms, and write the posts. The goal is to make SuperWellness genuinely findable by the people looking for what we do.



Priority 04: Video,
 & Ongoing Content

Coordinate video content featuring our CEO and Head of Wellbeing Strategy — scripting, briefing contributors, and managing the process. Write all
 sequences and campaigns. Maintain a content calendar across all priorities. Produce a monthly report the team uses to make decisions.



Day to Day - what the work looks like



- Own the content calendar — planning, scheduling, and delivering across all four priorities. Quality and relevance is more important than quantity

- Write the CEO's LinkedIn content — capturing a voice that sounds like a real person with a clear point of view

- Research what CHROs, CEOs, and HR Directors engage with on LinkedIn — understand the audience before writing for it

- Write all campaign copy:
 sequences, LinkedIn posts and articles, course landing pages, accreditation content, event materials

- Write and maintain website copy that is structured for both search engines and AI-powered discovery tools — clear, specific, and built around how people actually search for wellbeing expertise

- Work closely with the Digital Operations Lead to improve conversion rates and deliver continuously improving results

- Identify suitable guest post opportunities — relevant publications, sector platforms, and newsletters — approach them, and write the posts

- Plan, script, and coordinate video testimonials and thought leadership clips — you brief and direct the contributors, you don't film

- Use AI tools to support your work, but apply critical judgement throughout — content must read as genuinely considered and human, and plans must be grounded in what is actually implementable

- Produce a monthly content report: what is working, what is not, what to change



This is a B2B role. Our audiences are senior leaders, HR Directors, and wellbeing professionals. Experience in consumer brands, influencer content, or high-volume e-commerce is less relevant here. Editorial judgement and the ability to write for a professional audience matter more than follower counts.



Skills & Experience



Essential

- 3+ years of B2B content or marketing experience — professional services, health, HR, education, or training preferred

- Strong copywriting across formats: LinkedIn,
 campaigns, web copy, video scripts, long-form articles

- Demonstrable LinkedIn growth — company page or personal brand — with results you can show us

- Working knowledge of writing for SEO: awareness of keywords, page structure, internal linking, meta descriptions, and how AI-driven search tools surface and rank content

- Experience identifying and securing guest post placements, and writing the content

- Experience writing
 sequences and campaigns, with an understanding of what drives performance

- Experience coordinating video content — scripting, briefing contributors, managing the process end to end

- Able to write convincingly in another person's voice — matching tone, perspective, and register

- Confident using AI tools as part of your workflow, with the critical thinking to know when the output needs work

- Excellent written English — senior UK professional audience is the baseline

- Self-directed — manages own deadlines and priorities without close supervision

- Available to work UK business hours (GMT/BST) from the Philippines



Desirable

- HubSpot or equivalent CRM / marketing automation experience

- Canva or similar for basic social graphics and content assets

- Exposure to HR, wellbeing, L&D, or occupational health sectors

- Experience writing thought leadership content or summarising research for a senior executive audience

- Familiarity with B2B accreditation or professional standards bodies

- Experience managing or growing a 
pany page



Reward



Salary: $1,200–$1,500 per month depending on experience, paid in USD

25 days paid leave per year, inclusive of 8 UK bank holidays

Private medical insurance (individual cover) after 3 months

We run quarterly performance targets as a team. When the previous quarter's target is met, the following quarter everyone finishes at 1pm on Fridays. If you'd prefer the cash equivalent instead, that's a straightforward conversation.



Please include in your application:



- A cover note — not a template. Tell us which part of this role is most relevant to your experience, and what you would prioritise in the first 90 days

- LinkedIn evidence — a company page or personal profile you have managed, with a brief note on what you did and what the results were

- 2–3 copy examples — at least one
 sequence and at least one LinkedIn post or article, written for a professional audience

- One example of SEO or guest post work — a page you wrote for search, or a guest post you placed and wrote, with a short note on the brief and outcome

- One video coordination example — a link to a video you coordinated but did not film, with a short note on your involvement

- Portfolio site if you have one



Work samples are required. Applications without work samples will not be reviewed.



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid task: write two LinkedIn posts and one
 against a real brief. 



Selection Process



1. Application review

Work samples and CV reviewed. We aim to respond within two weeks.



2. Video call with the CEO — 20 minutes

An initial conversation about your background and experience.



3. Paid content task

Two LinkedIn posts and one
 against a real SuperWellness brief. Paid for your time.



4. Interview with the CEO and other members of the team — 45 minutes

A broader conversation about strategy, approach, and fit. We will also answer your questions about the role and the business.



Working Here - what to expect.



SuperWellness is a small business with a clear focus. We are growing, the work is varied, and you will have direct access to senior people. We expect a high standard of work and give people the space and trust to deliver it.



This is a full-time contractor role, which is remote and Philippines-based, working UK business hours. You will be expected to provide your own professional-spec, reliable equipment — a capable laptop, stable broadband connection, and a suitable working environment. 



The role will suit you if you:



- Set a high bar for your own work and notice when something is not good enough

- Have excellent commercial acumen and are motivated by driving commercial results through content

- Have a genuine interest in wellbeing, leadership, and how organisations function

- Work without needing close direction and flag problems early

- Take feedback as useful information rather than a problem

- Want to be part of building something that will make a difference



How to apply



Send your application to 
 — subject line: Content Strategist Application

Include your cover note, work samples, and the examples listed above. Applications without work samples will not be reviewed. We consider applications on a rolling basis.

title: Senior Video Editor · Reels, Shorts & TikTok · CapCut Expert · Remote · Full-Time
description:
Ceartas is hiring a Senior Video Editor to own our short-form content engine. You'll edit 8-15 Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikToks per week for our founder and brand channels — cinematic, fast-paced, modern.



You're an editor first. Cuts, pacing, sound design, colour, motion. But you also stay close to trends — you watch what's working on social, you know which formats are exploding this week, and you bring ideas to the table when you spot one we should ride. Reports to the CEO and CMO.



- Edit 8-15 short-form videos per week (Reels, Shorts, TikTok, LinkedIn)

- Cut to a rhythm — beat-matched, hook-driven, no slack frames

- Grade Sony FX3A footage from S-Log3 to cinematic Rec.709 using LUTs

- Build text-behind-subject effects, kinetic typography, glow treatments

- Design auto-caption styles that match the Ceartas brand voice

- Source and sync trending audio (you spot it before it peaks)

- Mimic high-performing creator formats and adapt to our brand

- Pitch ideas when you spot a trend worth riding

- Manage your project pipeline in Notion or ClickUp

- Deliver final exports in correct specs per platform

- Iterate fast — feedback is direct, turnarounds are tight



Must-Have Editing Skills



- Expert-level CapCut Desktop AND Mobile (primary editors)

- Strong working knowledge of Final Cut Pro AND/OR DaVinci Resolve

- Deep understanding of LOG profiles and LUT workflows

  (S-Log3 ? Rec.709 conversion, stacking technical + creative LUTs)

- Smart Cutout / Subject Tracking / Text Behind Subject effects

- Auto-caption tools with custom brand styling

- Sound design: beat-matched cuts, SFX, music ducking

- Colour grading: HSL, curves, scopes, skin tone correction

- Export specs: H.264, HEVC, 10-bit, proper bitrates per platform

- Motion graphics basics — kinetic text, overlays, transitions

- Canva proficiency for thumbnails, overlays, and social assets



What Makes You Different (Beyond Editing)



- You scroll Reels and TikTok daily and treat it as research

- You can name top creators in any niche off the top of your head

- You watch a viral video and instantly clock why it worked

- You bring ideas to editing sessions — not just executing briefs

- You spot trends within 24-48 hours of them breaking

- You ship volume — a B+ shipped today beats an A+ shipped next week

- You're not precious — feedback is fast, blunt, and you adapt without ego



Must-Have Soft Skills



- Detail-obsessed and decisive — you spot frame-level errors others miss

- Outstanding eye for design and typography

- Flexible and resilient — handles fast turnarounds without losing quality

- Excellent communicator in written English (Slack, Loom, async)

- Self-directed — you don't need micromanagement

- Comfortable handling occasional adult-themed footage professionally

  (Ceartas operates in the creator-economy anti-piracy space)



Schedule

- Full-time, fully remote

- Working week: Wednesday to Sunday (weekends are core social windows)

- Some flexible / late hours during the first month for training

- Must overlap ~4 hours/day with Dubai timezone (GMT+4)

- Stable, reliable internet (50 Mbps+ minimum)

- Mac OS preferred (our studio is Mac-based)



What We Offer



- Fully remote

- 15 paid days off per year + public holidays + your birthday off + 13th month payment

- Company-paid health insurance (full coverage)

- Home equipment provided (Mac, monitor, peripherals as needed)

- Direct mentorship from the CEO

- A vibrant startup environment with a supportive, diverse team

- Employee recognition and reward program

- Inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and equal opportunity

- Growth path: this role can scale into Head of Content as we grow

- Real impact: your videos drive the growth of a Sony-backed brand



Portfolio Requirement (NON-NEGOTIABLE - DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT A PORTFOLIO)



We will not review applications without a portfolio. Résumés don't matter here — your work matters.



Submit:



1. A reel of your best short-form edits

2. At least ONE example of a video where you graded LOG/log-profile footage

3. At least ONE example with text-behind-subject, kinetic typography,

   or modern social effects

4. Links to live posted videos on Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube

5. A 2-3 sentence note on what YOU contributed (vs. what was provided)

6. Bonus: a Reel of yours that performed exceptionally well (500K+ views)

Acceptable portfolio formats:

 or Vimeo private link



How to Apply

- Portfolio link is a strong plus (not mandatory if your test is excellent)



???? SALARY

$400–$600 USD/month, full-time, paid weekly. Long-term position with raises based on performance.



???? START DATE

This week (ASAP).



?? HOW TO APPLY — TEST REQUIRED (no test = no reply)



I receive too many copy-paste applications. The ONLY way to be considered is to complete this test and submit it with your application.



THE TEST — Plan for 2 to 3 hours.



1. Open this product page:





2. Generate 10 images of THIS EXACT PRODUCT (the Celesta pendant chandelier).



PART A — 5 LIFESTYLE SCENES

The product hangs above a kitchen island inside a Parisian apartment.

Vary across the 5 images: time of day, kitchen style, camera angle, decor details.

All 5 must clearly read as "Parisian apartment, kitchen island, Celesta pendant".



PART B — 5 CLOSEUP DETAIL SHOTS

Close-up shots of the product itself, showing the high-end textures, materials, and craftsmanship up close.

Vary the focal point across the 5 (glass, metal finish, hardware, bulb area, overall composition).

- Images must look like 16K professional interior photography.

- Tools allowed: ChatGPT Images OR Gemini ONLY (no Midjourney, no Flux).

? The 10 final images (Google Drive link)

? The exact prompts you used for each

? Which tool/version you used

? How long the test took you

? Portfolio link (optional but recommended)

Ross

We are a fast-growing e-commerce skincare brand running paid ads on Meta 
 & Instagram) and we are looking for a talented video editor to join our team remotely.

You will receive a base avatar video (AI-generated talking head via Arcads) and your job is to transform it into a high-converting Meta ad by adding:

- Proven experience editing short-form video for paid ads (Meta, TikTok)

- Comfortable sourcing B-roll from social platforms and/or generating it with AI tools

- Fast turnaround — we move quickly and need someone who does too

- Hungry to grow — this is not a job for someone looking to just clock hours





What we offer:



- Paid test edit before we start (you will be compensated for your time)

- Weekly pay — not monthly

- Performance bonuses for creatives that generate strong results

- Long-term collaboration — we grow together





How to apply:

Send your application with:



- A short introduction about yourself and your experience with paid ad editing

- A link to your portfolio or examples of videos you have edited for ads

Applications without a portfolio link and WhatsApp number will not be considered.



We are serious about this. We want someone who is serious too. If you have the skills and the hunger. Apply now!

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Project Manager (Digital Marketing & Coaching Focus)

Remote | Full-Time | Cross-Functional Teams



We’re looking for a highly organized and proactive Project Manager with a passion for digital marketing, personal development, and coaching. In this role, you won’t just manage timelines—you’ll lead client and internal projects from start to finish, ensuring everything runs smoothly, efficiently, and with purpose.



If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with creative and strategic teams, and know how to keep digital campaigns on track while fostering positive relationships, this one’s for you.



As our Project Manager, you’ll own multiple client and internal projects across the coaching and digital marketing space. You’ll lead initiatives related to content creation, campaign launches,
 marketing, funnel builds, virtual events, and more—coordinating across departments like design, copywriting, and tech.



You’ll be the central point of alignment, keeping deliverables on track, supporting client needs, and ensuring deadlines are met without sacrificing quality.



Key Responsibilities

-Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of digital marketing & coaching-related projects

-Serve as the primary liaison between internal teams, stakeholders, and clients

-Define project goals, timelines, and deliverables aligned with business and coaching outcomes

-Coordinate across content, design, automation, and client success teams

-Manage timelines using tools like ClickUp, Trello, or Asana

-Run daily/weekly stand-ups, team syncs, and progress check-ins

-Create and improve SOPs, workflows, and systems that enhance team efficiency

-Maintain organized documentation, task tracking, and communication logs



What We're Looking For

-2–5 years of project management experience, preferably in digital marketing or coaching industries

-Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and juggle multiple active projects

-Familiarity with marketing campaigns, launches, or coaching program operations

-Strong experience using project/task management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, etc.)

-Exceptional communication and leadership skills

-Highly detail-oriented, results-driven, and comfortable in remote work environments



Bonus: Experience with funnels,
 platforms (e.g., HighLevel, ActiveCampaign), and coaching client onboarding



What We Offer

-100% remote work with a collaborative, mission-driven team

-The opportunity to manage high-impact projects in coaching and personal development

-Flexible schedule with a culture of ownership and accountability

-Room for growth into strategic or leadership roles

-A team that values clarity, purpose, and transformation—in work and in life



Apply

Assist with document control tasks, including file naming, revision history, document logs, and folder organization

Able to summarize information clearly

ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA, GMP, medical device, PPE, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or manufacturing documentation experience

Experience with CAPA, NCR, audits, training records, supplier records, or document control

Experience with Zoho WorkDrive, Zoho Projects, Zoho Creator, or similar systems

Experience preparing audit evidence or regulatory files

This role requires someone who is careful, consistent, and comfortable working with detailed documentation. Accuracy is very important. You must be able to follow instructions and ask questions when something is unclear.

What quality, regulatory, compliance, or documentation experience do you have?

title: Appointment Setter and Customer Support Representative (CSR) (Weekend Support)
description:
From 8 am to 8pm Saturday and Sunday Toronto Timezone (24 hours) 

More shifts are available for the right candidate.

Reports to: Customer Service Manager



Company Mission:



Harris Plumbing is a 52-year plumbing business located in Barrie, Ontario, Canada. We are striving to grow our company 30% a year, and we are on track to be the largest pure plumbing service company in our area. Our mission is to serve homeowners with quality plumbing diagnostics and work, speed, and customer service. 



Company Values:



Integrity: Do the right thing when no one is watching 

Courage: Try new things, and don’t be afraid to make mistakes 

Teamwork: Support the team and the company first and foremost 

Professionalism: Do quality work, learn new skills, and improve upon the past 



Position Overview:



Harris Plumbing is looking for a motivated and sales-focused Appointment Setter / CSR to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who is driven and motivated, proven to be effective with outbound sales, has very good spoken English, is organized, and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 



The primary role is to call past clients and recommend and book appointments to install promotional plumbing products and services. These products may include smart water shut-off systems, hot water recirculation pump systems, Reverse Osmosis systems, and more.



The Appointment Setter will also pick up any inbound calls to book in jobs professionally and promptly. Once a technician has completed a job, follow up to check on client satisfaction. These “happy calls” are an opportunity to confirm everything was done well, revisit unresolved recommendations, and show genuine appreciation. By taking a few extra minutes to connect, we help reinforce the client’s confidence and create long-term loyalty.



Other Responsibilities:



- Follow up on outbound sales leads and estimates 

- Assist with Customer Service duties 

- Answer inbound customer calls 

- Schedule incoming service calls 

- Assist with light dispatching duties for weekend technicians (typically one technician)



Requirements:



- Strong communication and customer service skills 

- Comfortable making outbound calls 

- Ability to multitask and stay organized 

- Experience with scheduling or dispatching is an asset 

- Plumbing or home service industry experience is considered an asset 

- Positive attitude and team-oriented mindset 



Key Performance Indicators: 



Inbound Call booking rate 85%-95% 

Inbound Call Duration under 3 minutes 

Follow-up Call Completion 80%+ 

Ring Time: 3 Rings or less 

Outound Appointment Set rate of 5% 

Target of 120 calls per 12 hour shift



What We Offer:



Friendly and supportive work environment 

Opportunity for growth within the company 

Training provided 

Competitive pay based on experience

title: Business Development Partner (Commission-Only)
description:
Obsidian Connects works with software development and design agencies across the US and Europe. We connect them with businesses that have a clear operational problem and need a technology partner to solve it. The verticals we focus on include healthcare, logistics, property management, legal services, finance, retail, and real estate.

We are looking for Business Development Partners to identify businesses in these verticals, do the initial outreach, qualify their interest, and hand confirmed prospects to us. We handle everything after that.

To hand a lead over, four things must be confirmed. The specific operational problem driving the need. That you have reached the person who can actually approve the engagement. Whether budget has been allocated or they are still in early evaluation. And that there is genuine interest in moving forward with a technology partner.

Compensation is 10% of Obsidian's revenue from every deal your lead produces, including monthly retainers. Every retainer client your lead produces pays you $250 per month for as long as that client stays active. Five retainer clients is $1,250 per month in recurring income from introductions you already made. That number grows every time you add another.

This is commission-only. There is no salary or fixed hours. If you are looking for a salaried position, this is not the right fit. If you are open to building recurring income through your own effort, let's talk.
